notes.title: Demo 0.1.8 Update
notes.content:
[p]Based on the serious frame drop issue in the game version, this update mainly focuses on performance optimization.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Optimizations[/b]:[/p][p]
[/p][olist][*][p]Greatly optimize the stuttering problem and improve the stability of the picture.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimize the display of the battle end page.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimize the damage font during the battle process.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimize the success rate of generating a black hole with 3 debuffs in the Witch's talent.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimize the display of equipment drops.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimize the logic of dragging equipment in the backpack.[/p][/*][/olist][p]
[/p][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b]:[/p][p]
[/p][olist][*][p]Fix the situation where the number of Lava Boulders +1 and the effect of the Split Sphere do not take effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix the bug that some corresponding spheres cannot be equipped with the corresponding skills.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix the bug that the equipped equipment disappears.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix the problem that the attribute of converting life recovery to shield recovery does not take effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix the problem that the red dot prompt in the task system does not disappear.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix some problems of the Return Sphere.[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: demo 0.1.7 update
notes.content:
[h1][b]Function Adjustments:[/b][/h1][olist][*][p]Given that more features for the Endless Mode have not yet been launched and the current experience is poor, the Endless Mode will be disabled in the demo.[/p][/*][*][p]Disable the Leaderboard function.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjust the equipment drop mechanism.[/p][/*][*][p]Add a new Equipment Encyclopedia.[/p][/*][*][p]Add a new Sacrifice function.[/p][/*][*][p]Add a new Rune System.[/p][/*][*][p]Add a new Quest System.[/p][/*][*][p]Add a new Achievement System.[/p][/*][/olist][h1][b]Optimization Adjustments:[/b][/h1][olist][*][p]Adjust the skill acquisition mechanism: change the skill acquisition frequency from every [b]Level 3[/b] to every [b]Level 2[/b], allowing players to grow faster.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduce attribute gains; players need to rely more on equipment and skills for in-game battles.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimize Wizard skills: adjust the status of debuffs to enable better burst damage with elemental states.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimize equipment affixes: adjust the attributes and descriptions of some affixes.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimize the accuracy of the mini-map.[/p][/*][/olist][h1][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h1][olist][*][p]Fix the issue where affixes duplicate when leveling up.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix bugs related to the "Return" and "Orb of Circulation" (Note: "归返" and "环绕宝珠" are translated based on common in-game terminology; adjust if specific official names exist).[/p][/*][*][p]Fix the clipping issue caused by some skills.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix the bug where equipment disappears when switching to "Renyin" (Note: "壬午" is a Chinese era/ganzhi term; retain the Pinyin if it refers to a specific in-game mechanism/character).[/p][/*][*][p]Fix the abnormal description of equipment affixes.[/p][/*][/olist][h1][b]Subsequent Demo Optimizations:[/b][/h1][olist][*][p]Optimize for lag issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimize class Builds (BD, short for "Build") and Skill Orbs.[/p][/*][/olist][h1][b]Notes:[/b][/h1][p]Due to adjustments to equipment affixes and the game's core logic, old save files may cause data conflicts and result in bugs when running. For a better experience, please delete old save files.
[b]Important[/b]: Delete the old save files in Steam Offline Mode first, then start the game. Enable Online Mode again only after creating a new save file to prevent overwriting by cloud saves.[/p]

notes.title: Final update of demo content and Early Access release date
notes.content:
[h1][b]Thank You for Your Feedback and Attention, Players of [/b][i]God Forsaken[/i][/h1][p]First, we would like to express our sincere gratitude to all players of [i]God Forsaken[/i] for your recent feedback and ongoing attention.[/p][p]
[/p][p]In light of the numerous game releases scheduled for September and the feedback we received from the recent demo test, we have decided to adjust our release date to ensure we are fully prepared. The original release date of [b]September 19th[/b] will be postponed to [b]October 22nd[/b]—yes, that’s right, after the Autumn Sale and New Release Festival! We kindly ask for your understanding, and we hope you’ll keep some space in your wallet for us.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Additionally, we will optimize and adjust the demo based on recent feedback, and new content will be added to the demo.[/p][h2][b]Demo Update Preview (v0.1.7, Expected Around September 8th)[/b][/h2][olist][*][p][b]Endless Mode will be disabled[/b]: The original intention of Endless Mode was to allow players to farm equipment, but we found it did not achieve this goal in practice.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Leaderboard function will be disabled[/b]: To be honest, after reviewing the leaderboard data, we realized it had lost its original purpose.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Adjustments to the skill acquisition progression[/b]: Skill acquisition will now occur every 2 levels (down from every 3 levels). This will significantly enhance your ability to build skills and develop your Build (BD). Correspondingly, stat gains will be reduced, so please pay attention to skill combinations when making your selections![/p][/*][*][p][b]Partial release of the Quest System[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Partial release of the Achievement System[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Partial release of the Rune System[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]New Equipment Compendium added[/b]: This will provide clearer guidance for players who enjoy collection. The Early Access (EA) version will introduce more affixes and equipment tiers based on this foundation.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Note on old save files[/b]: Adjustments to equipment affixes and core game logic may cause data conflicts and bugs when using old save files. For a better experience, please delete your old save files. [b]Important[/b]: Delete the save files while in Steam Offline Mode before launching the game. Enable Online Mode only after creating a new save file to avoid overwriting via cloud saves.[/p][/*][/olist][p]
[/p][p]Once again, thank you for your support![/p]

notes.title: V 0.1.5 Update
notes.content:
[p]The optimization mainly focuses on reducing lag to make the game run more smoothly. As for new content: yes, we have completed the content for the EA (Early Access) version, but the overall effect hasn't met our expectations. We hope to release the EA version in a better state.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Therefore, we kindly ask all players to be a little more patient.[/p]

notes.title: Update of Version 0.1.3

notes.title: V0.1.1 Update
notes.content:
1.Added the function of changing equipment by right-clicking.
2.Fixed the issue where the damage inflicted by monsters on the character was sometimes abnormally high.
3.Fixed the problem that the luck attribute incorrectly increased the drop rate of rare items.
4.Optimized the loading speed of item refresh in the backpack and the store.
5.Optimized the performance of the mouse pointer.
6.Fixed the problem that the identification of interactive objects and high-quality equipment was not displayed on the mini-map within the level.

notes.title: Version 0.1.0 Update
notes.content:
1.Fixed the issue where the interface for inlaying runes would pop up multiple times occasionally when picking up a rune chest.
2.Fixed the problem that sometimes the attribute selection interface would display as empty when choosing attributes.
3.Fixed the problem that the progress of the health bar on the main interface and the health bar above the head in the scene was different.
4.Fixed the issue that no items would be displayed when entering the in-game store.
5.Fixed the problem that the torch with incompletely implemented functions would be refreshed in the store.
6.Fixed the issue that the weapon attacks on the equipped weapons would not trigger the bleeding status.
7.Fixed the problem that the blinding effect caused the abnormal behavior of the monsters.

notes.title: Version 0.0.9 Update
notes.content:
1.Optimized the situation where the special effects of some skills cause lag.
2.Increased the character's movement speed within the camp.
3.Blocked the inlay of some auxiliary skills that conflict with the main skills.
4.Added prompts for the effective scenes in the description of the talent effects.
5.Fixed the problem that attributes are not increased when skipping the upgrade process.
6.Blocked the operation of using shortcut keys to call out other interfaces in special scenes and interfaces.
7.Optimized the problem that the teleportation portal is difficult to interact with after clearing the level.
8.Fixed the problem that the health bars of elite and BOSS monsters are not displayed.
9.Added the function that when selecting runes, you can view the details of the equipped skills.
10.Fixed the problem that the equipment cannot be picked up.
11.Fixed the problem that the talent sometimes cannot be activated.
12.Fixed the problem that when giving up the game while selecting attributes/skills, the attribute/skill 13.selection interface will not appear when re-entering the game.
Removed the restriction that you must carry a torch to enter the level.

notes.title: V0.0.8版本更新
notes.content:
1. Optimized the situation where the special effects of some skills cause lag.
2. Increased the character's movement speed within the camp.
3. Blocked the inlay of some auxiliary skills that conflict with the main skills.
4. Added prompts for the effective scenes in the description of the talent effects.
5. Fixed the problem that attributes are not increased when skipping the upgrade process.
6. Blocked the operation of using shortcut keys to call out other interfaces in special scenes and interfaces.
7. Optimized the problem that the teleportation portal is difficult to interact with after clearing the level.
8. Fixed the problem that the health bars of elite and BOSS monsters are not displayed.

notes.title: Version 0.0.7 Update
notes.content:
1.Optimized the logic of in-game attribute locking and exclusion.
2.Fixed the issue that the sound effect settings on the login interface cannot be saved.
3.Added the display of effect descriptions corresponding to the San values in each interval.
4.Fixed the problem that when dodge is replaced with petrification, switching to the torch makes the character's head lose the petrification effect.
5.Fixed the problem that in the settings menu - graphics, the last two options cannot be scrolled to the bottom, resulting in the inability to change the settings.
6.Fixed the issue of incorrect CD display in the skill options.
7.Fixed the problem that skill upgrades cause abnormal damage overflow.
8.Fixed the problem that equipment cannot be changed when the store page is opened.
9.Optimized the generation of equipment affixes.

notes.title: Version 0.0.6 Update
notes.content:
Fixed the problem that the final boss at the end of the level doesn't spawn.
Added a skip function in the interfaces for rune inlaying, skill selection, and attribute selection.
Fixed the display problem of skills starting from the second slot.
Fixed the problem that the teleportation portal cannot be interacted with after clearing the level.
Added an automatic settlement function after clearing the level.
Fixed the problem of skill errors occurring when a skill is fully upgraded.
Fixed the problem that the attack speed occasionally resets to zero.
Fixed the problem that when gambling for equipment, dragging and dropping results in the generation of white-quality equipment.
Optimized the problem that the merchant being too close to the campfire makes it easy to accidentally touch.

notes.title: V0.0.5 Update
notes.content:
This is a major update based on the feedback received on the first day of the demo. Regarding the issues such as the inability to pause, equipment pickup, and level completion settlement on the first day, we immediately carried out optimizations after understanding them. We hope that everyone will experience a significant improvement after these optimizations.
[olist]
[*] Fixed the issue of occasional failure to settle after completing a level.
[*] Fixed the issue of the skill bar UI disappearing.
[*] Fixed some issues with throwing the flying axe.
[*] Optimized the equipment pickup. Now, you can use the shortcut key "E" to pick up equipment when getting close to it.
[*] Added the function of automatically pausing the game when opening the character/inventory interface during the game.
[*] Fixed the issue that books cannot be discarded.
[*] Temporarily removed books from the monster drops.
[*] Optimized the positions of some NPCs in the camp and adjusted the positions of the warehouse/merchant to be closer to the campfire.
[/olist]
